task: PR 01 — StatusOrb: distinct 'preparing' appearance + live segment arc during active renders (closes the deferred W-MIX visual-check item)

frontend/src/components/ui/StatusOrb.tsx.summary: Added a `preparing` tier and extended the segment progress arc to active states. (1) New derived `isPreparing = isTrulyProcessing && (activeJob.reason_code === 'SEGMENT_PENDING' || 'LOADING_MODEL' || activeJob.indeterminate === true)` — the same predicate useStudioChapter.ts uses; no new prop or signal. Its branch sits ABOVE the existing isTrulyProcessing (running spinner) branch because both are true during the model-load window. The preparing branch renders a distinct dimmed, spinner-less orb: a static center dot (data-testid='orb-icon-preparing') plus a calm dimmed ring pulse via the `.is-preparing` class (no Loader2/.animate-spin), tooltip 'Preparing… loading voice model'. (2) The completed-vs-total segment arc (real doneSegments/totalSegments, `showArc`/`percent`, drawn as the r=9.5 --accent circle) now also renders during `running` and `preparing`, not only the idle 'stable' branch — the hasSeg/allSegsDone/segPercent calc was hoisted above the branch chain so all branches share it. No fabricated advance during the indeterminate window; the arc reflects last-known real counts. The outer decorative ring gets `.is-preparing` (opacity 0.45) during preparing instead of `.is-running`.

frontend/src/theme/components/core.css.summary: Added `@keyframes orb-preparing-pulse` (opacity 0.35→0.65) and a bare `.is-preparing` rule (`--preparing-pulse-duration: 2s`) next to `.is-running`. Distinct lower opacity band from is-running's calm-pulse (0.7→1.0) so preparing reads as dimmer. More-specific ScriptView rules (.script-line.is-preparing / .script-render-group.is-preparing, in ScriptView.css) still override this via specificity — no regression to the segment-span preparing pulse.

frontend/src/theme/base.css.summary: Extended the prefers-reduced-motion essential-state exemption block to re-enable the bare `.is-preparing` StatusOrb pulse (animation-duration var(--preparing-pulse-duration,2s)) alongside the existing .script-line.is-preparing / .script-render-group.is-preparing exemptions — the orb pulse is an essential 'working/warming-up' cue (WCAG 2.3.3), a pure opacity breathe with no movement, so it survives reduced-motion rather than freezing.

frontend/tests/unit/components/ui/Status.summary: Added 4 TDD tests (revert-checked: all 4 fail on pre-change source, 13 existing pass): preparing tier renders instead of running spinner on LOADING_MODEL; preparing triggers on indeterminate flag alone; preparing uses .is-preparing (reduced-motion-safe) not .animate-spin; live segment arc renders at real done/total (5/10 → dashoffset ≈29.85) while a job is actively running.

flow_impact: Frontend-only, presentation-layer. No change to the progress/ETA math, the backend preparing signal, or any wire contract — the orb derives preparing from fields already present on the Job it receives (reason_code/indeterminate). Matching spec updated in the same change: design-docs/specs/progress-presentation.md §2.7 (spec_version 1.10.3 → 1.11.0, new StatusOrb bullet + corrected reduced-motion bullet to reflect the actual base.css essential-state exemption).
